lines.en: label dormwartwo1:
scene anewwar1
: Ladies and...the one gentleman we have! And also Molly!
lines.zh: : 女士们，还有……我们这儿仅有的一位绅士！另外还有 Molly！

lines.en: : Are you going to do this every year?!
lines.zh: : 你打算每年都来这一套吗？！

lines.en: : The time has come for us to once again link our fates! Binding ourselves together in a way that will bring a good half of us closer to the person who is {i}once again{i} this year’s prize...
lines.zh: : 是时候让我们{i}再一次{/i}把命运拴在一起了！用一种能让我们当中相当一部分人更加接近今年那个奖品——那个人的方式，把彼此紧紧绑在一起……

lines.en: scene anewwar2
: Sensei! Woooooo!
lines.zh: : 老师！呜哦哦哦哦！

lines.en: : As excited as I am to once again have my life put on the line for the sake of your enjoyment, I would like to remind everyone to please not attack me if your floor loses. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 虽然能再次为了各位的欢愉而把小命押上，让我激动不已，但我还是想提醒大家，如果你们那层楼输了，请千万别攻击我。谢谢。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Senpai. I’ll be here to clean up the blood so nobody gets in trouble when something like that {i}does{/i} happen.
lines.zh: : 别担心，前辈。{i}真{/i}出了那种事，我会在这儿把血擦干净的，这样谁都不会惹上麻烦。

lines.en: : Thanks, Imani. I feel so much better and safer now.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Imani。我现在安心多了，也安全多了。

lines.en: As you may have figured out by now, today marks the beginning of the second annual Super Mega Whatever-Other-Adjectives Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: 想必你们已经猜到了，今天标志着第二届「超级无敌随便再堆点形容词」宿舍大战的开幕。

lines.en: Also, it’s Halloween. Which I guess means it’s okay for all of my students to show up in their costumes despite it still being school hours and...some of them barely wearing anything at all.
lines.zh: 另外，今天是万圣节。我想这就是说，尽管还在上课时间，我的学生们全都可以穿着万圣节装扮来学校——而且……其中有些人几乎什么都没穿。

lines.en: And yes, I am complaining about this- but not because I am worried that it may get all of us into some sort of trouble. But because I have never wanted to have sex with this many people at the same time before.
lines.zh: 没错，我是在抱怨——但不是因为这可能会给我们所有人惹上什么麻烦，而是因为我从来没有过同时想和这么多人上床的冲动。

lines.en: The next 48 hours will likely be Hell- but it will be a Hell we can walk through together...on the way to countless erections and brighter days.
lines.zh: 接下来的 48 小时大概会是地狱——但那会是一座我们可以携手走过的地狱……通往数不清的勃起和更光明的日子。

lines.en: scene anewwar3
: Uhh...Senpai? You alive?
lines.zh: : 呃……前辈？你还活着吗？

lines.en: scene anewwar4
: I’m fine. Just reflecting on what could very well be my final moments.
lines.zh: : 我没事。只是在回味这很可能是我人生最后时光的当下。

lines.en: : Reflect on your own time, Mas- uhh...Sensei. We’ve got some contests to assign and we were kind enough to let you stay in the room to listen to them this time around.
lines.zh: : 您有空再回味吧，老——呃……老师。我们还有好些比赛要分配呢，而且这次我们够意思了，让您留在屋里旁听。

lines.en: : I still don’t understand why I wasn’t allowed to do that the first time.
lines.zh: : 我还是不明白，为什么第一次的时候不让我听。

lines.en: : And I still don’t understand why no one’s brought up the fact that this is the second time we’ve done this in just {i}one school year.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而我也不明白，为什么没人提过，这可是我们{i}一学年之内{/i}第二次办这活动了。

lines.en: scene anewwar5
: Don’t worry, Ayane. One day, we’ll stand on that rooftop together. You, me, and my twenty unborn children.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Ayane。总有一天，我们会一起站在那个屋顶上。你，我，还有我那二十个尚未出生的孩子。

lines.en: : Weird inside jokes aside, who’s ready to kick this off with our first contest announcement?!
lines.zh: : 抛开那些奇怪的内部梗不谈，谁准备好听我们的第一场比赛宣告了？！

lines.en: : Woo! Dorm Wa- wait, why am I the only one clapping?
lines.zh: : 呜哦！宿舍大——等等，怎么只有我一个人在鼓掌？

lines.en: scene anewwar6
: Contest numero uno! A fierce battle between two of the tiniest girls in class! And one that would send the dudes into a hormonal frenzy if they weren’t all up in space doing space stuff!
lines.zh: : 第一场比赛！班上个头最小的两个女孩之间的激烈对决！要不是男生们全都跑到太空里搞太空的事去了，这场比赛准会让他们荷尔蒙爆表！

lines.en: : From the first floor- we have Sana Sakakibara...facing up against second floor denizen...Molly MacCormack! In a contest to determine which one of them is the {i}true{/i} gamer girl!
lines.zh: : 来自一楼的是——Sana Sakakibara……迎战二楼的居民……Molly MacCormack！比赛的内容是决出谁才是{i}真正{/i}的游戏少女！

lines.en: scene anewwar7
: Heh...heh...heh...as if there needs to be a contest at all...
lines.zh: : 呵……呵……呵……好像还真需要比一场似的……

lines.en: : For eternity, I have sat idly by...evading the sharp edges of my father’s words as he says, “Molly...maybe it’s time to go outside?”
lines.zh: : 长久以来，我一直无所事事地枯坐着……躲避着父亲那些锋利的话语——「Molly……也许你该出去走走了？」

lines.en: : If only ‘ye could see me now...one long rest from proving to the world that those hours {i}wasted{/i} were no waste at all...but-
lines.zh: : 要是他现在能看到我就好了……一次漫长的休整，只为向世界证明那些被{i}浪费{/i}的光阴根本不是浪费……不过——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. We get it. You’re sedentary.
lines.zh: : 行啦行啦。我们懂了。你就是久坐不动。

lines.en: scene anewwar8
: I prefer the term “extrovertedly challenged,” thank you very much. But yes, I suppose I shall let my skills do the talking rather than my mouth.
lines.zh: : 我更喜欢「外向障碍者」这个说法，非常感谢。不过好吧，我想我还是让我的技术来说话，而不是靠嘴。

lines.en: : I do have a question for my opponent, though. Is such a thing permitted?
lines.zh: : 不过我有一个问题想问我的对手。这种事允许吗？

lines.en: : Does it relate to the contest?
lines.zh: : 和比赛有关吗？

lines.en: : Only in the fact that it relates to her and she is going to be {i}in{/i} the contest.
lines.zh: : 只在于它和她有关，而她是要{i}参加{/i}比赛的。

lines.en: : You can...ask...it’s okay...
lines.zh: : 你……可以问……没关系的……

lines.en: scene anewwar9
: Then, and please don’t take this the wrong way- but what in Scáthach’s cervix are you supposed to be this year?
lines.zh: : 那么——请千万别往坏处想——看在 Scáthach 的子宫颈的份上，你今年这身到底扮的是什么东西？

lines.en: : That...
: That is a good question...
lines.zh: : 那是个好问题……

lines.en: : Is this how you envision Zagull Throat Spear? The head is larger and greener than I pictured. But I will admit that I am no expert when it comes to the orc race.
lines.zh: : 这就是你心目中的 Zagull Throat Spear 吗？脑袋比我想象的更大也更绿。不过我承认，在兽人这个种族上我算不上专家。

lines.en: : This is just a...mask I found at a Halloween store, but...I...think that...Zagull might look...a little-
lines.zh: : 这只是……我在万圣节商店里找到的一个面具，但是……我……觉得……Zagull 可能看起来……有点——

lines.en: : As your DM, I want it to be known that I will never come between you and the way you want to play your character.
lines.zh: : 作为你们的 DM，我想让大家知道，我绝不会插手你和你扮演自己角色的方式。

lines.en: : But I swear on the Cliffs of Moher that if you say Zagull looks even remotely similar to this sinful costume, that you will have disadvantage on everything for the rest of forever.
lines.zh: : 但我以莫赫悬崖起誓，如果你敢说 Zagull 和这身罪恶的装扮有半点相似，你这辈子剩下的所有判定都将永远处于劣势。

lines.en: : It’s just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : It’s just an...orc mask...
lines.zh: : 只是个……兽人面具……

lines.en: scene anewwar10
: With the first contest decided, it’s time to move on to one of only {i}two{/i} contests that will be returning for a second run this year!
lines.zh: : 第一场比赛定了下来，是时候进入今年仅有的{i}两场{/i}返场比赛之一了！

lines.en: : And considering that the vast majority of the class wanted to participate in this one, I’d like to remind you all that selections were completely random and that {i}I{/i} would be competing if I had any say in this!
lines.zh: : 鉴于班上绝大多数人都想参加这一项，{i}我{/i}想提醒大家，人选完全是随机抽的——要是我能说了算，我早就自己上了！

lines.en: : To prevent any casualties, the participants for this contest have already been revealed at an earlier date. But, for the sake of clarity and to get the formal contest introduction out of the way...
lines.zh: : 为了避免任何伤亡，本场比赛的参赛者已经在早些时候公布过了。不过为了清楚起见，也为了把正式的比赛介绍走完……

lines.en: : The second ever date war will be between Futaba {i}Fuku{/i}yama and Noriko {i}Naka{/i}yama!
lines.zh: : 史上第二届约会大战，将在 Futaba {i}Fuku{/i}yama 与 Noriko {i}Naka{/i}yama 之间展开！

lines.en: scene anewwar11
: Nakayara{i}kawa{/i}yama, please. I changed my last name to become closer to the man I will be {i}dating{/i} in this contest.
lines.zh: : 请叫我 Nakayara{i}kawa{/i}yama。我改了姓，好让自己在这场比赛中更贴近我{i}约会{/i}的那个男人。

lines.en: : So unless Futaba plans on changing her name to Fuku...arak- see, no. It just doesn’t have the same ring to it.
lines.zh: : 所以除非 Futaba 打算把自己的名字改成 Fuku……arak——你看，不行。听着就是没那个味儿。

lines.en: : I...I don’t think I’m quite ready to change my last name yet anyway...
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得我还没准备好改姓呢……

lines.en: scene anewwar12
: I’m just messing around! Best of luck, Futaba! I’m sure you’ll do-
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的！祝你好运，Futaba！我相信你会——

lines.en: : What are those weapons called?
lines.zh: : 你身上那些武器叫什么？

lines.en: scene anewwar13
: Hm? What?
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么？

lines.en: : Your weapons. What are they called?
lines.zh: : 你那些武器。叫什么名字？

lines.en: : I think they’re, like...dagger things? Why?
lines.zh: : 我觉得……算是……匕首之类的东西吧？怎么了？

lines.en: : Because if you lay so much as a finger on Sensei, I am going to take those {i}dagger things{/i} and rearrange your face.
lines.zh: : 因为只要你敢碰老师一根手指，我就用那些{i}匕首玩意儿{/i}把你脸重新排列一遍。

lines.en: : Jeez, Chika. I feel like there’s a little more to that vitriol than just the reigning champion trying to prevent someone else from taking her crown.
lines.zh: : 天哪，Chika。我觉得你这股怨气里，可不只有卫冕冠军想保住自己王冠那么简单。

lines.en: : Why does it even matter if she touches him or not? It’s not like you own him.
lines.zh: : 她碰不碰他到底有什么关系？他又不是你的所有物。

lines.en: : Button up your pants. You look like a whore.
lines.zh: : 把你裤子扣上。看着跟个婊子似的。

lines.en: scene anewwar14
: You’re literally in bondage gear!
lines.zh: : 你自己穿的可是实打实的束缚装啊！

lines.en: scene anewwar15
: Yeah, I have no idea how Chika was even allowed into school dressed like that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也不知道 Chika 穿成那样到底是怎么被放进学校的。

lines.en: : Forget about Chika, have you {i}seen{/i} Tsuneyo? Girl’s such a queen she’s got me questioning my morals before lunch time.
lines.zh: : 别管 Chika 了，你{i}看见{/i} Tsuneyo 了吗？那姑娘气场强得像女王，害我在午饭前就开始质疑自己的道德底线了。

lines.en: : I feel like lunch is the only time I spend in this building {i}not{/i} questioning my morals.
lines.zh: : 我感觉在这栋楼里，只有午饭时间是我{i}不用{/i}质疑自己道德底线的时候。

lines.en: : I feel like I need a cold shower. Hot damn.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我需要冲个冷水澡。天杀的。

lines.en: : You know, maybe you’ll be a good judge for this contest after all.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，也许你终究会成为这场比赛的好裁判。

lines.en: : Game’s over. They all win. Enjoy your harem.
lines.zh: : 游戏结束。她们全赢。好好享受你的后宫吧。

lines.en: : Excuse me, madam speaker? I have a question about the contest.
lines.zh: : 打扰一下，议长女士？我有个关于比赛的问题。

lines.en: scene anewwar16
: Which one of us is “madam speaker?”
lines.zh: : 我们俩谁是「议长女士」？

lines.en: : I’ll handle this. What’s up, Nodoka? What’s your question?
lines.zh: : 我来应付。怎么了，Nodoka？你有什么问题？

lines.en: : I was just wondering whether or not Yumi would be participating in this year’s Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道，Yumi 会不会参加今年的宿舍大战。

lines.en: : Hey, yeah. What is the first floor going to do when they’re down a player? If somebody on the second floor needs to sit out as well, I-
lines.zh: : 对啊。一楼少一个人的话该怎么办？如果二楼也得有人弃权的话，我——

lines.en: : Me. Pick me. I’ll sit out.
lines.zh: : 我。选我。我弃权。

lines.en: : Oh. Okay, yeah. That makes more sense.
lines.zh: : 哦。好吧，嗯。这样更说得通。

lines.en: : That’s...actually a good question. I didn’t really know what to do for Yumi, so I just wrote down “karaage” as the tenth girl on the first floor.
lines.zh: : 这……其实是个好问题。我真不知道该拿 Yumi 怎么办，所以我就在一楼第十个女孩的位置上写了个「唐扬炸鸡」。

lines.en: : I don’t remember any chickens moving in. In fact, come to think of it, Todd hasn’t even come back yet.
lines.zh: : 我不记得有鸡搬进来过。说起来，Todd 到现在都还没回来呢。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo probably killed them all as soon as they showed up.
lines.zh: : 大概它们一露面就被 Tsuneyo 全宰了。

lines.en: : I do have a history of doing that.
lines.zh: : 我确实有干这种事的前科。

lines.en: : If I may make a suggestion, I’d be open to competing against Yumi should she return to the class.
lines.zh: : 如果可以提个建议的话，要是 Yumi 回到班上，我愿意和她比一场。

lines.en: scene anewwar17
: I don’t think she’s {i}allowed{/i} to return to the class after what she did to you. She’s suspended, remember?
lines.zh: : 她对你做了那种事之后，我觉得她不会被{i}允许{/i}回到班上。她被停学了，记得吗？

lines.en: : Would it be an issue if our contest were to take place {i}outside{/i} of class?
lines.zh: : 如果我们的比赛在{i}课外{/i}进行，会有问题吗？

lines.en: : If it’s not on school grounds, she should be allowed to do anything, right?
lines.zh: : 只要不在校园里，她应该就能做任何事吧？

lines.en: : You looking for revenge or something, Nodoka? Not sure why you’d want to compete against somebody who nearly killed you.
lines.zh: : 你是在找机会报仇什么的吗，Nodoka？我不太明白你为什么想跟一个差点杀了你的人比赛。

lines.en: : Oh! Revenge sounds fun! I like this idea! How do you feel about it, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 哦！报仇听起来很有意思！我喜欢这个主意！你觉得呢，Ayane？

lines.en: : I mean...I think it’s fine...but I doubt Yumi would even want to-
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得没问题……但我怀疑 Yumi 根本就不想——

lines.en: : Let me handle Yumi.
lines.zh: : Yumi 的事交给我。

lines.en: scene anewwar18
: She’s actually coming over to my place later today and I can just ask her about it then.
lines.zh: : 其实她今天晚些时候会来我家，到时候我直接问她就行了。

lines.en: : No idea if she’ll actually agree or not. But if Nodoka is cool with going up against her, I might be able to convince her.
lines.zh: : 不知道她会不会真的答应。不过如果 Nodoka 不介意和她对阵，我也许能说服她。

lines.en: : Worse comes to worst, I’ll just take her place and compete on her behalf.
lines.zh: : 最坏的情况，我就顶替她的位置，代表她出战。

lines.en: : You’re still hanging out with her? Aren’t you afraid she’ll go postal on you next?
lines.zh: : 你还在跟她混在一起？就不怕下一个发疯的对象是你？

lines.en: scene anewwar19
: Aren’t you afraid that keeping your pants unbuttoned might make the room smell kinda fishy?
lines.zh: : 你就不怕一直不扣裤子扣子，会把屋子里弄得有点腥味吗？

lines.en: : Aww, I love it when you two whisper sweet nothings to one another! It’s so cute!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，我最喜欢看你们俩互相说着甜言蜜语了！太可爱了！

lines.en: scene anewwar20
: If nobody has any objections, I guess there’s no harm in seeing if she wants to join or not. We’ll just keep Tsuneyo on guard this year since her costume has a gun.
lines.zh: : 如果没有人反对，我想问问她想不想参加也没什么坏处。今年就让 Tsuneyo 负责警戒好了，毕竟她的装扮上带着枪。

lines.en: : She’s not the only one with a gun, you know.
lines.zh: : 带枪的可不止她一个，你知道的。

lines.en: : Can you at least tell me what I’m doing before I head out?
lines.zh: : 我走之前，你至少能告诉我要比什么吧？

lines.en: : Wait, you’re leaving {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : 等等，你{i}现在{/i}就要走？

lines.en: : Yeah. The principal stopped me in the hall and said I wasn’t allowed to be in school dressed like this, so I’m not even supposed to be here right now.
lines.zh: : 是啊。校长在走廊里拦住我，说我穿成这样不许待在学校，所以我现在根本就不该在这儿。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, hide.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，藏起来。

lines.en: scene anewwar21
: Then, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……

lines.en: : You and Otoha are competing against one another in a popularity poll that we’ll be tallying the results for sometime near the end of the competition.
lines.zh: : 你和 Otoha 要比的是人气投票，我们会在比赛接近尾声的时候统计结果。

lines.en: scene anewwar22
: Easy! Thanks, Uta! See y’all later!
lines.zh: : 简单！谢了，Uta！回头见！

lines.en: : Wait a second! Won’t both floors just vote for the girl that will help their team win? No one’s going to vote against their own floor.
lines.zh: : 等一下！两个楼层不都会把票投给能让自己队伍赢的那个女孩吗？没人会投票反对自己楼层的。

lines.en: : You will, right?
lines.zh: : 你会的，对吧？

lines.en: scene anewwar23
: Huh? What?
lines.zh: : 哈？什么？

lines.en: : You wouldn’t vote against your own {i}girlfriend,{/i} would you?
lines.zh: : 你总不会投票反对自己的{i}女朋友{/i}吧？

lines.en: : Uhhhhhh...{i}no. Of course not.{/i}
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……{i}不会。当然不会{/i}。

lines.en: : Good. But, just in case you don’t remember, I was weirdly popular at my last school for no reason whatsoever. I’ve got this in the bag.
lines.zh: : 很好。不过，万一你忘了——我上一所学校里莫名其妙就很受欢迎，毫无理由的那种。这场我赢定了。

lines.en: : But...Chika’s popular too. And you’re still new-ish here, so barely anybody even knows you yet and...and that’s kind of a disadvantage, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 可是……Chika 也很受欢迎啊。而且你来这儿还算是新人，几乎没什么人认识你……这算是劣势吧？

lines.en: : Ehh. If I lose, I lose. Not like it’s the end of the world if I don’t get to spend a little extra time with our weirdo teacher.
lines.zh: : 嗯。输了就输了呗。就算不能多陪咱们那个怪胎老师待一会儿，也不是什么世界末日。

lines.en: scene anewwar24
: Can you stop calling him that, please?
lines.zh: : 你能别那么叫他了吗？

lines.en: : Why? You call him that all the time.
lines.zh: : 为什么？你自己也天天那么叫他啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, but it’s a joke when I do it. The way you say it makes it sound like an insult.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我那是开玩笑。你那么说听起来就像在骂人。

lines.en: scene anewwar25
: Sorry to interrupt but, to answer your question, it’s not just {i}our{/i} floors who are voting on the poll. It’s the other classes too. So if you want to get campaigning, you better do it now.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断一下，不过回答你的问题——投票的可不只是{i}我们{/i}这两层楼，别的班级也会投。所以你要是想拉票，最好现在就开始。

lines.en: : Wait, seriously? The contests start in the morning and there are only a few hours left of school.
lines.zh: : 等等，真的假的？比赛明天早上就开始了，学校里只剩几个小时了。

lines.en: : Yup! Which is why I said you better get started now!
lines.zh: : 对啊！所以我才说你最好现在就开始！

lines.en: : Honestly, I’m surprised Uta even okayed this challenge given how much of a handicap there is.
lines.zh: : 说实话，考虑到劣势这么大，我还挺惊讶 Uta 居然批准了这场比拼。

lines.en: : Never doubt the amount of girls who want to be dommed by the prince of Kumon-mi Academy.
lines.zh: : 永远别低估有多少女孩想被 Kumon-mi 学院的王子支配。

lines.en: scene anewwar26
: You were one of them weren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你也是其中之一吧？

lines.en: : The...the next contest we’ll announce is Ayane’s! Which is a stand-up comedy showdown between her and floor two’s very own Tsuneyo Tojo- who has been dreaming of this moment her entire life!
lines.zh: : 我……我们要公布的下一场比赛是 Ayane 的！这是一场单口相声对决，对手是二楼的 Tsuneyo Tojo——她这辈子都在梦想着这一刻！

lines.en: scene anewwar27
: Like a light bulb, I will shine.
lines.zh: : 我会像灯泡一样，闪闪发光。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo...you know there...are much brighter things...to compare yourself to...right?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo……你知道……还有比灯泡亮得多的东西……可以拿来比喻自己……对吧？

lines.en: : Doing that would be wrong when I expect to give a performance so average that you’ll all remember it for the rest of your lives.
lines.zh: : 那就不对了，因为我打算奉献一场平庸到让你们余生难忘的表演。

lines.en: : Oh...uhh...okay...
scene anewwar28
: As someone who is also extremely average, you should help me write material, Zagull Throat-Sana.
lines.zh: : 作为一个同样极其平庸的人，你应该帮我写段子，Zagull Throat-Sana。

lines.en: : I’m not...very funny and...and Ayane is also my...best friend, so...
lines.zh: : 我……不太搞笑，而且……而且 Ayane 也是我的……好朋友，所以……

lines.en: : So I would like her to win...
lines.zh: : 所以我希望她能赢……

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : I will remember this when you come to {i}me{/i} for help with your stand-up routine.
lines.zh: : 等你来找{i}我{/i}帮你的单口表演时，我会记住这件事的。

lines.en: : I think I’d need a little more help than...just you anyway...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……我想要的可不止是你一个人的帮助……

lines.en: scene anewwar27
: Anything to say before moving on, Ay-
lines.zh: : 在继续之前有什么要说的吗，Ay——

lines.en: : Nope! Keep ‘em coming, Uta!
lines.zh: : 没有！继续报，Uta！

lines.en: : R-Right! Then...the next contest we’ve got will be mixing things up a little and sucking even {i}more{/i} people into the contest for the first time ever!
lines.zh: : 好——好的！那么……我们要公布的下一场比赛会稍微换换花样，并且有史以来第一次把{i}更{/i}多人卷进比赛里！

lines.en: scene anewwar29
: The Midnight Mom Mosh will take place immediately after the stand-up contest and pit Touka’s mom up against Makoto’s in a battle to determine which one is...more motherly!
lines.zh: : 「午夜妈妈大乱斗」将在单口相声比赛之后立刻举行，让 Touka 的妈妈和 Makoto 的妈妈正面对决，比一比谁……更有妈妈味！

lines.en: : Can I concede now or is this a thing I actually must attend?
lines.zh: : 我现在能认输吗，还是说这场我真的必须到场？

lines.en: : I’m sure your mother will do just fine, Makoto. While mine may be extremely talented and well-versed in a plethora of different skills and activities, I’m sure your mother is exceptional in her own ways as well!
lines.zh: : 我相信你妈妈会表现得很好的，Makoto。虽然我妈妈可能才华横溢，精通五花八门的技能和活动，但你妈妈肯定也有她自己出众的地方！

lines.en: : Yeah, about that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，说到这个。

lines.en: : Touka...
lines.zh: : Touka……

lines.en: scene anewwar30
: Yes, Yasu? What can I do for you?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Yasu？有什么我能为你做的吗？

lines.en: : What’s it like to have a mom?
lines.zh: : 有妈妈是什么感觉？

lines.en: : Yasu, please do not make me cry today of all days. Do you have any idea how long it took to apply all of this fake blood and makeup?
lines.zh: : Yasu，请别在偏偏是今天的日子里让我哭出来。你知道涂完这些假血和妆花了多长时间吗？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Touka. I didn’t mean to speak out of turn again. I’ll crawl back into my hole and await further instructions.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Touka。我不是有意又多嘴的。我会爬回我的洞里，等待下一步指示。

lines.en: : You may speak whenever you want, my dear. But it would be lovely if you’d remain as positive as possible on holidays like this one as you and I are the glue that holds this class together!
lines.zh: : 你想什么时候说话都行，亲爱的。不过在这种节日里，如果你能尽量保持积极就再好不过了——毕竟你和我可是把这个班粘在一起的胶水！

lines.en: scene anewwar31
: Glue is sticky and makes other things sticky as well.
lines.zh: : 胶水是黏的，也会把别的东西弄黏。

lines.en: : It certainly does.
lines.zh: : 确实如此。

lines.en: : Are you saying we are sticky?
lines.zh: : 你是说我们是黏的吗？

lines.en: : I’ve changed my mind. Please remain quiet until the delegation of contests is complete. Your talk of stickiness is both distracting me and making me feel quite uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 我改变主意了。在比赛分配完毕之前请你保持安静。你那些关于黏的发言既让我分心，又让我觉得相当不适。

lines.en: : Thank you for once again trying to include me. If only I were not so pathetic. Then, maybe we would be able to get everyone sticky without you coming to despise my existence.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你又一次试图把我算进去。要是我没这么没用就好了。那样的话，也许我们就能让所有人都黏在一起，而你也不至于厌恶我的存在了。

lines.en: scene anewwar32
: Ready to redeem yourself after last year’s defeat, Makoto?!
lines.zh: : 准备好一雪去年的败绩了吗，Makoto？！

lines.en: : Absolutely not. It’s one thing for {i}me{/i} to win a contest, but for my {i}mother{/i} to win one? Against one of the most influential women in Kumon-mi? There’s not a chance.
lines.zh: : 完全没有。{i}我{/i}自己赢一场比赛是一回事，让我{i}妈{/i}赢一场？对手还是 Kumon-mi 最有影响力的女人之一？一点机会都没有。

lines.en: : But Maki knows all sorts of stuff about-
lines.zh: : 可 Maki 懂各种各样的东西啊——

lines.en: : Rubber penises and sex positions? Yes. Yes, she does. But neither of those things make her “motherly,” which is precisely what this contest entails.
lines.zh: : 橡胶阳具和性爱体位？是的。她确实懂。但这两样都算不上「有妈妈味」，而这场比赛考的恰恰就是这个。

lines.en: : So unless Touka’s mother is completely helpless when it comes to performing the tasks a {i}standard{/i} mother performs, I have no hope whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 所以除非 Touka 的妈妈在{i}普通{/i}妈妈会做的事情上一窍不通，否则我一点希望都没有。

lines.en: scene anewwar33
: It doesn’t matter if ya win or lose so long as ya have fun and enjoy your time together.
lines.zh: : 赢也好输也好，只要你玩得开心、享受和你妈在一起的时光就行。

lines.en: : You’re right. And I’m sorry. I didn’t-
lines.zh: : 你说得对。还有对不起。我不是——

lines.en: : I think this sorta thing might be good for you and Maki. And if this thing weren’t happenin’ so late at night, I’d probably come along with ya.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这种事对你和 Maki 可能挺好的。而且如果不是大半夜的，我说不定会跟你一起去。

lines.en: scene anewwar34
: I wouldn’t worry about that. Besides, it won’t be {i}you{/i} as soon as today’s bell rings anyway. So just focus on winning {i}your{/i} competition and I’ll...
lines.zh: : 这我倒不担心。再说了，今天铃一响，{i}你{/i}也就不是你了。所以你专心赢{i}你{/i}的比赛就好，我会……

lines.en: : I’ll try to do the best with mine.
lines.zh: : 我会尽力打好我自己的。

lines.en: scene anewwar10
: Okay, okay, okay! We’re startin’ to wind down, so let’s get these last few outta the way before we start worryin’ about the pre-game interviews later!
lines.zh: : 好好好！我们开始收尾了，所以在开始操心之后的赛前采访之前，咱们赶紧把最后这几个搞定！

lines.en: : Our next contest is a battle that will put your most essential knowledge to the test!
lines.zh: : 我们的下一场比赛，将考验你们最核心的知识储备！

lines.en: : That’s right, folks! It’s a contest to see how much the competitors know about the reward they’re competing {i}for!{/i}
lines.zh: : 没错，各位！这是一场比赛，看看参赛者到底有多了解她们{i}争夺{/i}的那个奖品！

lines.en: : It’s a battle between supernatural and super-awkward as Yasu Yasui faces off against Rin Rokuhara, self-proclaimed queen of the friend zone!
lines.zh: : 这是超自然与超级尴尬之间的对决——Yasu Yasui 迎战 Rin Rokuhara，自封的「朋友区女王」！

lines.en: scene anewwar35
: Hey! That isn’t a {i}self-{/i}proclaimed title at all! I’ve never once called myself that!
lines.zh: : 喂！那才不是我{i}自{/i}封的头衔！我从来没这么叫过自己！

lines.en: : It’s kinda true, though.
lines.zh: : 不过说实话也差不多吧。

lines.en: : It’s {i}because{/i} of my friendship with Sensei that I know so much about him! That’s not a negative thing! And there’s no way Yasu can even come close to that!
lines.zh: : 正是{i}因为{/i}我和老师是朋友，我才这么了解他！这又不是什么坏事！而且 Yasu 根本不可能比得上！

lines.en: : Come close to what? What are we doing?
lines.zh: : 比得上什么？我们要做什么？

lines.en: : I said “shush.”
lines.zh: : 我说了「安静」。

lines.en: : Sorry, Touka. I thought I heard someone say my name, but I forgot that no one would ever taint their lips that willingly.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Touka。我以为听见有人叫我的名字，却忘了没人会那么心甘情愿地玷污自己的嘴唇。

lines.en: : Just don’t get beaten out by the ESP or whatever it is she’s got going on, Rin. I’ll be rooting for you just as much as you’ll be rooting for me.
lines.zh: : 只要别输给她那套超能力什么的就行，Rin。我会像你支持我一样支持你的。

lines.en: scene anewwar36
: Hah...yeah.
lines.zh: : 哈……是啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure everything will be fine in the end.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我相信最后一切都会没事的。

lines.en: : Coming up sometime either before or after the last contest-
lines.zh: : 在最后一场比赛之前或者之后的某个时候——

lines.en: : We’re still working out the schedule for day two-
lines.zh: : 第二天的赛程我们还在敲定——

lines.en: : Comes what is sure to be one of the most divisively adorable competitions we’ve had thus far!
lines.zh: : 将会迎来迄今为止最具争议、也最可爱的一场比赛！

lines.en: : You know, Ayane- I’ve always said, “Nothing ventured, nothing gained!”
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，Ayane——我一直都在说，「不入虎穴，焉得虎子！」

lines.en: : I’ve never heard you say that once! But please, proceed!
lines.zh: : 我可从没听你说过一次！不过请继续！

lines.en: : And it is that exact quote that I may or may not have said that made me realize that, sometimes, I have to make my best friend really, really uncomfortable!
lines.zh: : 而正是那句我可能说过、也可能没说过的名言让我意识到，有时候，我必须让我最好的朋友非常、非常地不自在！

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : That’s right, everyone! The next contest we’ve got on the docket is titled “Misfit Maid Madness” and is a battle to see who the best maid is between Io Ichimonji and Maya Makinami.
lines.zh: : 没错，各位！我们要公布的下一场比赛名为「怪咖女仆大狂欢」，是一场比拼谁才是最佳女仆的对决，双方是 Io Ichimonji 和 Maya Makinami。

lines.en: : You’ve gotta be fucking kidding me.
lines.zh: : 你他妈在跟我开玩笑吧。

lines.en: scene anewwar37
: I have a question.
lines.zh: : 我有个问题。

lines.en: : Yes, Io?
lines.zh: : 什么，Io？

lines.en: : No.
: That wasn’t a question.
lines.zh: : 那不是个问题。

lines.en: : Can’t I just do the participation thing again? That’s the only reason I put on a costume in the first place. Nobody told me we were changing jobs.
lines.zh: : 我就不能像上次那样走个参与奖吗？我一开始穿这身衣服就是为了那个。没人告诉我我们还换了工种啊。

lines.en: : I was going to, but then you got all dressed up and it made me feel all warm and mushy inside, so I kept it a secret. Please don’t hate me.
lines.zh: : 我本来要说的，可后来你精心打扮了一番，看得我心里又暖又软，所以我就瞒着了。别恨我好不好。

lines.en: scene anewwar38
: Yeah, I’m not doing this.
lines.zh: : 行，这事我不干。

lines.en: : Cool. Let’s just call it a tie then.
lines.zh: : 好啊。那就当平局吧。

lines.en: : Fine by me.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。

lines.en: : What’s wrong with being a maid, Maya? I think you’d be good at it.
lines.zh: : 当女仆有什么不好的，Maya？我觉得你会很适合。

lines.en: scene anewwar39
: Of course I’d be good at it. Have you seen me? I’m adorable. But that doesn’t mean I have any desire to actually {i}be{/i} one. I don’t have the energy for that sort of job.
lines.zh: : 我当然会做得很好。你没看见我长什么样吗？我超可爱的。但这不代表我真想{i}当{/i}女仆。那种活儿我没那个精力。

lines.en: : It’s just for a little while, though. And you can go right back to being all cold and aloof right after.
lines.zh: : 不过就一小会儿嘛。完事之后你马上就能变回那个冷冰冰、爱答不理的样子。

lines.en: : Sure. But you’re not taking into account the fact that I would be a maid waiting on {i}Sensei,{/i} which is a thing he would never allow me to live down.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说。可你没考虑到，我会变成一个伺候{i}老师{/i}的女仆——而他绝对会拿这件事笑我一辈子。

lines.en: : It’s true. I really wouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 没错。我真的不会放过这个机会。

lines.en: : See?
lines.zh: : 你看？

lines.en: scene anewwar40
: Wait, can we do this maid thing in private? Because if it’s {i}just{/i} Sensei, I’d probably be fine with it.
lines.zh: : 等等，这个女仆环节能私下进行吗？因为如果{i}只有{/i}老师在的话，我大概还能接受。

lines.en: : Sure! That works for-
lines.zh: : 当然！那对——

lines.en: : No way! Vetoed! I wanna see the maids too! Plus, I’m a real, certified judge this year and I deserve the right to weigh in on which one of you I’d rather have drawing ketchup hearts on my food!
lines.zh: : 不行！否决！我也想看女仆！再说了，今年我可是有证的正式裁判，我有权决定更想让你们谁来在我的食物上画番茄酱爱心！

lines.en: : I also don’t like the idea of private maid showings since I understand exactly how much Sensei likes maids and that sounds dangerous for everyone involved!
lines.zh: : 我也不赞成私下的女仆表演，因为我太清楚老师有多喜欢女仆了——那对在场的所有人来说都太危险了！

lines.en: : That is a risk I am willing to take.
lines.zh: : 这个风险我愿意承担。

lines.en: : Ami, you’re not even competing in this contest.
lines.zh: : Ami，你这场比赛根本就没参赛啊。

lines.en: : If Sensei’s heart is involved, I am always competing.
lines.zh: : 只要牵扯到老师的心，我就永远在参赛。

lines.en: : Come to think of it, what {i}is{/i} Ami competing in? Because I didn’t write anything for her and Kirin.
lines.zh: : 说起来，Ami 要{i}比{/i}什么来着？因为我和 Kirin 的项目我什么都没写。

lines.en: : Uta, this was literally your only job.
lines.zh: : Uta，这本来就是你唯一的工作啊。

lines.en: scene anewwar41
: Yeah! But between this and the harem ranking, I’ve got barely any “me” time left! And any time I {i}did{/i} have went toward making this costume!
lines.zh: : 是啊！可是在这事儿和后宫排名之间，我几乎一点「自己的时间」都没有了！就算{i}有{/i}，也都花在做这身衣服上了！

lines.en: : Then...I guess it’s good that {i}you’re{/i} going to be the one representing your floor in the costume contest this year.
lines.zh: : 那么……我想，由你来代表{i}你们{/i}楼层参加今年的变装比赛，倒是件好事。

lines.en: scene anewwar42
: But what {i}isn’t{/i} good for you is the fact that you’ll be facing off against our secret weapon in Miku Maruyama fulfilling the role of a gyaru while Chika is out being a...provocative dog?
lines.zh: : 但{i}不{/i}妙的是，你的对手将会是我们的秘密武器——由 Miku Maruyama 扮演的辣妹，而 Chika 则出去当一只……充满挑逗性的狗？

lines.en: : I think she’s a wolf girl.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她是狼女吧。

lines.en: : Whatever it is, she’s hot.
lines.zh: : 不管是什么，她很辣。

lines.en: : Wasn’t she talking shit on your vagina like ten minutes ago? Are you already over that?
lines.zh: : 她十分钟前不是还在嘲讽你的阴道吗？你已经不在意了？

lines.en: : Yeah, now I kinda just wanna hate fuck her.
lines.zh: : 是啊，现在我只想跟她来一发带着恨意的炮。

lines.en: : Kirin, you’ve got a problem. And while I’d normally say this is something you should talk to a counselor about, I just remembered who your counselor is. So...never mind.
lines.zh: : Kirin，你有问题。虽然我通常会说这种事你该去找心理咨询师聊聊，但我刚想起来你的咨询师是谁。所以……当我没说。

lines.en: : Uhh...good luck, Uta. We’re both undefeated so far, so I...
lines.zh: : 呃……祝你好运，Uta。我们俩到目前为止都还没输过，所以我……

lines.en: : I ain’t plannin’ on...takin’ it easy on you...
lines.zh: : 我可没打算……对你手下留情……

lines.en: scene anewwar43
: Good luck to you too, Miku! Here’s hoping neither one of us cracks before the time comes to be judged!
lines.zh: : 也祝你好运，Miku！希望我们俩在评审到来之前都别先崩溃了！

lines.en: : Cracks? What is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 崩溃？那是什么意思？

lines.en: : What that means, Sensei...is that we’ve added an extra layer to the costume contest this year!
lines.zh: : 老师，那意思是……今年的变装比赛我们加了一层新花样！

lines.en: : You see, a good costume will always be impressive. But what’s even {i}more{/i} impressive is when the person {i}wearing{/i} that costume is able to perfectly embody their character!
lines.zh: : 你看，一身好装扮总是能让人印象深刻。但{i}更{/i}令人印象深刻的，是{i}穿上{/i}那身装扮的人能完美地化身为自己所扮演的角色！

lines.en: : Amen!
lines.zh: : 阿门！

lines.en: : Which is why, starting with the final bell, Miku and I will take on the roles of our characters and attempt to remain in them until two nights from now, when we once again conclude at Sakaki-bar-a!
lines.zh: : 所以，从最后的放学铃响起开始，Miku 和我会进入各自的角色，并努力保持到两天后的夜晚——那时我们会在 Sakaki-bar-a 再次画上句号！

lines.en: : Is that...really the name of Sana’s family’s bar?
lines.zh: : 那……真的是 Sana 家那间酒吧的名字吗？

lines.en: : I love it. Twenty can’t come soon enough.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢。真希望二十岁快点来。

lines.en: : Any last questions before we put an end to this ceremony-ish thing?
lines.zh: : 在结束这场仪式什么的东西之前，还有最后的问题吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I still have no idea what my contest is.
lines.zh: : 有，我还是不知道我比什么。

lines.en: : Let’s see which one of us can please Imani the most.
lines.zh: : 那就比比我们俩谁更能让 Imani 舒服吧。

lines.en: : Let’s not!
lines.zh: : 别这样！

lines.en: : We’ll figure something out for you guys tomorrow and apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused you.
lines.zh: : 明天我们会给你们想出点项目的，对于可能造成的不便，我们深表歉意。

lines.en: scene anewwar44
: It is at this time that we’d like to thank all of you for attending the Second Annual Super Mega Ultimate Halloween Dorm Wars introduction ceremony.
lines.zh: : 现在，我们要感谢各位出席第二届超级无敌终极万圣节宿舍大战开幕仪式。

lines.en: : We’d also like to thank the Tsukioka Foundation and the Produce Delivery Administration for sponsoring this year’s event!
lines.zh: : 我们还要感谢月冈财团与农产品配送管理局对今年活动的赞助！

lines.en: : Those bastards.
lines.zh: : 那群混蛋。

lines.en: scene black
: This concludes our presentation!
lines.zh: : 我们的介绍到此结束！

lines.en: : And {i}that{/i} concludes our school day!
lines.zh: : 我们一天的校园生活也到{i}此{/i}结束！

lines.en: : Uta, you may now- wait. Where did Uta go?
lines.zh: : Uta，你现在可以——等等。Uta 去哪儿了？

lines.en: : She threw a smoke bomb thing on the ground as soon as the bell rang, but nothing happened so she kind of just ran away.
lines.zh: : 铃一响她就往地上扔了个烟雾弹似的东西，结果什么都没发生，所以她就那么跑掉了。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, Molly, if you’re going to do the interviews again this year, you can come with me to the broadcast club’s room for our microphones and stuff.
lines.zh: : 哦。那个，Molly，如果你今年还要做采访的话，可以跟我去广播社的房间拿麦克风什么的。

lines.en: : And for everybody else, get the Hell out of here and go have some sleep! We’ve got a big day ahead of us tomorrow!
lines.zh: : 至于其他人，赶紧给我滚出去睡觉！明天还有硬仗等着我们呢！

lines.en: One by one, the girls filter out of the classroom until I’m the only one left.
lines.zh: 女孩们一个接一个地走出教室，最后只剩下我一个人。

lines.en: And while I don’t exactly understand if my role as the “prize” is going to be exactly the same as it was last year and just determine which ten I sleep with in an unexciting manner...
lines.zh: 虽然我不太确定，我这个「奖品」的角色会不会和去年完全一样，只是以平淡无奇的方式决定我和哪十个人上床……

lines.en: I’m looking forward to it.
lines.zh: 我还是很期待。

lines.en: Even if it’s mildly threatening, being sought after is nice.
lines.zh: 就算带点轻微的威胁感，被人追逐的感觉也不错。

lines.en: And it’s times like this that remind me of that.
lines.zh: 而正是这样的时刻让我想起这一点。

lines.en: But with all of them heading back to the dorms and me having been banned from attending the “pre-game” interviews to avoid hearing any particular strategies...I have nothing left to do with the rest of my day.
lines.zh: 但她们都回宿舍了，而我为了不听到什么具体的战术，又被禁止参加「赛前」采访……我这一天剩下的时间便无事可做了。

lines.en: So, for what is probably the millionth time, I slide my hands into my pockets and begin to head home.
lines.zh: 于是，大概第一百万次地，我把双手插进口袋，开始往家走。

lines.en: Because even if the next 48 hours will be some of the most exhausting of my life, I’m sure it will all be worth it in the end.
lines.zh: 因为即便接下来的 48 小时会是我这辈子最筋疲力尽的一段时间，我相信最后一切都是值得的。

lines.en: And I’m sure that this installment of the legendary Dorm Wars will be just as good as the last.
lines.zh: 我也相信，这场传奇宿舍大战的这一部，会和上一部一样精彩。
